descriptions.w3d_d29g_crate_properties_load_8004b448: Crate start-up: clears the delay and vector state, reads the sixteen Crate.* properties with their defaults, scales hit points by the multiplier, sets the absolute delay and lifetime times from the engine clock, derives fall speed and the UXB, gravity, parachute and pushable flags, and releases the object at +244 unless WaitTillLanded is on.
